name: YKI Finnish, intermediate level (keskitaso)
fee: €190 for the whole intermediate test (2026). On subtest days: listening €43, speaking €84, reading €43, writing €70; listening + writing €113.
retake: Book and pay a new test. Since 1 January 2026 a paid registration is binding and can't be moved to another date.
prereq: None. Grade 3 (CEFR B1) in two subtests is the citizenship level: speaking + writing, listening + writing, or reading + speaking.
delivery: Four subtests (reading, writing, listening, speaking), each graded separately; a 5-hour day with breaks. All Finnish tests in spring 2027 are digital (typed). Register at yki.opintopolku.fi.

sections.title: Sounds and Me
objectives: Read Finnish aloud with the right vowel and consonant length.
Introduce yourself: name, country, languages, where you live.
Say and understand numbers, days and times.

sections.title: Around Town
objectives: Say where something is, where you come from and where you go (the six location cases).
Apply consonant gradation when adding endings (kauppa → kaupassa).
Understand and write short directions and meeting messages.

boss.name: The Double-Letter Troll
boss.taunt: Tuli, tuuli or tulli? One letter more and the meaning changes!
boss.defeat: Fire, wind and customs… you hear the difference now.

boss.name: The Gradation Gatekeeper
boss.taunt: Kauppa becomes what in the shop? Mind the double p!
boss.defeat: Kaupassa, kadulla, Helsingissä… you know the way.

boss.name: The Partitive Peddler
boss.taunt: One coffee or some coffee? Kahvi or kahvia? Choose!
boss.defeat: Kaksi kahvia, kiitos. You order like a local.

tips: Type your answers: the 2027 test is digital, and typing the right ending is the skill that grows fastest with practice.
15 minutes every day beats two hours once a week: reviews are spaced so words stay for months.
Read one Yle Selkouutiset article a day and listen to its audio: reading and listening grow together.
In the reading test, answer every question: wrong answers cost nothing.
In writing, cover every point the task asks for and always add a greeting and your name.
